options.name: annotation
options.description: A list of keyvalue-pairs of the form C(<+/-/:><key>[=<value>]). A V(+) denotes adding an annotation, a V(-) denotes removing an annotation, and V(:) denotes modifying an annotation. If setting or modifying annotations, a value must be provided.

options.name: autoremove
options.description: Remove automatically installed packages which are no longer needed.

options.name: cached
options.description: Use local package base instead of fetching an updated one.

options.name: chroot
options.description: Pkg chroots in the specified environment. Can not be used together with O(rootdir) or O(jail) options.

options.name: ignore_osver
options.description: Ignore FreeBSD OS version check, useful on C(-STABLE) and C(-CURRENT) branches. Defines the E(IGNORE_OSVERSION) environment variable.

options.name: jail
options.description: Pkg executes in the given jail name or ID. Can not be used together with O(chroot) or O(rootdir) options.

options.name: name
options.description: Name or list of names of packages to install/remove. With O(name=*), O(state=latest) operates, but O(state=present) and O(state=absent) are noops.

options.name: pkgsite
options.description: For C(pkgng) versions before 1.1.4, specify C(packagesite) to use for downloading packages. If not specified, use settings from C(/usr/local/etc/pkg.conf). For newer C(pkgng) versions, specify a the name of a repository configured in C(/usr/local/etc/pkg/repos).

options.name: rootdir
options.description: For C(pkgng) versions 1.5 and later, pkg installs all packages within the specified root directory. Can not be used together with O(chroot) or O(jail) options.

options.name: use_globs
options.description: Treat the package names as shell glob patterns.
